bead.title: Specify hybrid-async poison, repair, debt, and backpressure gates in TP-003
bead.description:
PROBLEM: TP-003 does not yet make the hybrid-async poison, repair, async apply debt, and backpressure gates explicit enough for a worker to implement or verify independently.

ROOT CAUSE: `docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/TP-003-verification-acceptance-criteria.md:211` defines the `objectlog/hybrid-async` success barrier and unknown-outcome replay gate, and `docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/TP-003-verification-acceptance-criteria.md:334` defines ordered batching evidence, but neither line requires explicit poison, operator repair, async apply debt, or backpressure acceptance gates.

PROPOSED FIX: Update governing artifact `docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/TP-003-verification-acceptance-criteria.md` to add or extend hybrid-async verification criteria for poison/fail-closed behavior, operator repair interaction, bounded async apply debt, and backpressure when SQLite lag or replay debt exceeds budget. Keep the criteria tied to `objectlog/hybrid-async`, TD-004, INV-5, INV-10, INV-11, INV-12, and INV-14, and require evidence fields for async lag, high-water advancement, and debt/backpressure thresholds.

NON-SCOPE: Code changes; implementing metrics, repair tools, or performance tests; changing existing evidence results; changes outside the four governing artifact references; altering existing dependency ID `pqueue-b207e65d`; weakening the required verification commands; editing `docs/perf/tp002-objectlog-hybrid-evidence.md` except as a separate child bead.

DEPENDENCY: parent `pqueue-b207e65d`.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestHybridAsyncPlanPoisonRepairDebtBackpressure: `rg -n 'hybrid-async|poison|repair|backpressure|debt|async apply|SQLite lag|fail closed|operator' docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/TP-003-verification-acceptance-criteria.md` succeeds and shows criteria for poison/fail-closed behavior, operator repair interaction, async apply debt, and backpressure gates.
2. TestHybridAsyncPlanNoPerfEvidenceMutation: `git diff --name-only` after the bead contains only `docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/TP-003-verification-acceptance-criteria.md`.
3. TestHybridAsyncPlanCargoGate: `cargo test -p pqueue-release ledger_path_honors_env_override_and_default` passes.
4. TestHybridAsyncPlanFmtGate: `cargo fmt --check` passes.
5. TestHybridAsyncPlanGoGate: `go test ./...` passes or records a no-Go-module skip with the exact command output.
6. TestHybridAsyncPlanLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
